svg.aria-label: At a glance. Role: AI/ML Engineer. Focus: speech AI, LLMs and RAG, real-time inference. Builds: voice agents, speech-to-text systems, RAG platforms, fine-tuned LLMs. Stack: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, FastAPI, ONNX Runtime, Docker. Based in Hyderabad, India. Speaks English, Telugu, Hindi and Spanish.
